-- Crystal Bells: two inharmonically-detuned oscillators beat against each other
-- for a bell-like clangor, ringing down with no sustain (struck-and-decay, not
-- held-and-expressive). Light chorus and reverb add shimmer; X lets you bend a
-- struck bell for glissandi.
import "constants"

function OnStart()
    SetOscillator(0, { waveform = OscWaveform.Square, level = 0.5, detune = 0.35, pitchFactor = 1.0 })
    SetOscillator(1, { waveform = OscWaveform.Triangle, level = 0.5, detune = -0.28, pitchFactor = 2.0 })

    SetAmpEnvelope({ attackMs = 2, decayMs = 1800, sustainLevel = 0, releaseMs = 1800 })
    SetFilterEnvelope({ attackMs = 2, decayMs = 1400, sustainLevel = 0, releaseMs = 1400, contour = 3.2 })
    SetFilter({ cutoff = 100, resonance = 0.2, type = "LP4" })

    SetChorus({ rateHz = 0.7, depth = 0.3, mix = 0.25 })
    SetReverb({ sizeMeters = 30, decayMs = 4000, dryDb = 0, mixDb = -8 })

    -- X (pitch bend): standard +/-2 semitones, for the occasional bell glissando
    SetCtrlSlot(0, { source = CtrlSource.X, curve = CtrlCurve.Linear, target = CtrlTarget.PitchBend,
                     valueType = CtrlValueType.BiPolar, depth = 2 / 12 })
end
